dialogue.name: JoJo-EpTitle,Sign
dialogue.speech: Episodio A Little Story From the Past ~My Name Is Doppio~

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: This is a little story from the past.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: We're going back to the summer of .

dialogue.name: JoJo-flashback
dialogue.speech: This is a women's prison on a remote island.

dialogue.name: JoJo-flashback
dialogue.speech: was sentenced to ten years for bank robbery and as*ault.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: She's been here for two years already.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: Push! Just a little bit more!

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: When could she have gotten pregnant?

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: Hey, you! Who the hell's this kid's father?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-flashback
dialogue.speech: A barnacle growing in your knee would be more believable than that.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: Looks like the baby made it.

dialogue.name: JoJo-flashback
dialogue.speech: The baby's eyes have been open ever since he was born.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: And he's not crying at all.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: This goes without saying, but we can't raise a baby here.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: We'll find someone to take him.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: A priest at a small church there took the child in.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Time passed, and the boy became known as someone

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: rather cowardly and a bit slow.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Well, I'll be going now. See you later, Mr. Frog.

dialogue.name: Man
dialogue.speech: Walk closer to the edge, you dumbass!

dialogue.name: Man
dialogue.speech: Don't you dare tell the priest about this.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: But I'm glad you didn't get squished.

dialogue.name: Girl
dialogue.speech: I also don't like guys who smell.

dialogue.name: Girl
dialogue.speech: I hate everything that's not beautiful.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Say, it's a bit hot out. Want to get something to drink?

dialogue.name: Priest
dialogue.speech: You want to become a sailor?

dialogue.name: Priest
dialogue.speech: It might be a good idea to get him a car.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: In order to build a garage next to his room,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: the priest started digging into the floor with a pick.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: As he carefully picked at the concrete...

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: The person he discovered was a woman.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: It was the woman who gave birth to the boy the priest took in.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: She couldn't move nor talk, but somehow, she was being kept alive.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: How many years had it been?

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: The woman had no sense of time.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: That night, the whole village burned,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: with strong winds carrying the fire to every single house.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: No one knows how it started.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Seven people died, and others went missing.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: On the list of the deceased were

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: the names of the priestand the boy he'd taken in.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Where the hell do you think you're walking, you dumbass?!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Guess I had the wrong idea.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Looks like you're down on your luck. Having a bad day?

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Or have you been having a streak of bad luck?

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I'd say so. I've had one problem after another.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Why not let me tell your fortune?

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Sardinia is your home, isn't it?

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: And it's been a while since you've been back here, hasn't it?

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: You can tell I'm a traveler just by looking at me.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Light and shadow, what's inside and what's out.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: You could probably call it two separate lives.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: But you take advantage of that secret and have an unyielding personality,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: which has earned you nothing but victories.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: There's something about your face that is very intriguing to someone in my field.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Please, let me tell you your fortune.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You're currently looking for someone very important to you.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Everyone spends their lives looking for someone.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: A beautiful girlfriend or a good friend...

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: But I guess it's nice to hear these things at times.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: How do you go about doing it?

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: I can tell just by looking at the shape of the mud splatter on your pants.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: It's been said for thousands of years that in Romani fortunetelling,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: the best results come from looking at the shape of something that formed coincidentally.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Because that is the symbol of fate.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The person you're looking for is your daughter.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: You came back to Sardinia to find the child of the woman you left fifteen years ago...

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: I know what I just said, but this is strange...

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: But you have one. I'm sure of it.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Please! My pride as a fortuneteller is on the line here!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Let go of my hand... Don't touch me...

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: I won't ask for payment... Actually, I'll pay you!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: You're friggin' annoying! Don't touch me!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: What good would it do for you to see it, huh?!

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: It appears you're not a Stand user.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: You have the wisdom to see people

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: for who they really are, and you made that your business.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: No one in this world is allowed to know who I really am.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: But I now know that you are indeed an excellent fortuneteller.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Out of respect for that, I'll be sure to k*ll you instantly so you don't feel any pain.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: He is also looking for my daughter and trying to find out my true identity.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I want you to tell me where he is right now.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: But I'm sure you'll encounter him soon.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and you will certainly encounter him here.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I was right! Light and shadow, what's inside and what's out.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: As long as you bear this secret, the death of people will bring you good fortune,

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: and you will never lose your splendor!

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: I've never seen a hand like this before!

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Huh? Something's wrong. It suddenly looks strange.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: This is my own hand! It changed before I even realized it!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I'm so glad you weren't squished.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's dangerous to be on the sidewalk.

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: And now for our next story,

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: the investigations involving the site of the crash off the Olbia coast in Sardinia.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Driver, do you have a cell phone?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: C-Could you stop for a sec, driver?

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I'll get out here! This is fine!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I just have to keep an eye out over there.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: This area was forgotten by history until about half a century ago,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: when a certain millionaire from India was enamored by the scenery of this coast,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: where the winds and cliffs met,and started living there.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There seems to be an extra digit on your meter...

dialogue.name: Taxi
dialogue.speech: So you actually think I rigged the meter

dialogue.name: Taxi
dialogue.speech: Is that what you think? Huh?!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: N-No... But , lire to get from the city to here seems a bit...

dialogue.name: Taxi
dialogue.speech: Like hell a guy on vacation doesn't have money!

dialogue.name: Taxi
dialogue.speech: I know you hid some in your pocket earlier.

dialogue.name: Taxi
dialogue.speech: I saw you hide an envelope in your pants.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Don't touch me... I-I'm getting a headache...

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Those who have seen what they shouldn't have seen

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: don't need to exist in this world!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Hey... Did you just hear a phone ring?

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Hey! I asked you a question!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: That phone's busted, so there's no way it could've rung!

dialogue.name: Taxi
dialogue.speech: H-Hell if I know! What are you—

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: There it is again! Where is it?

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Hey, what the hell? You have a car phone!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's the spot in the photo.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I just need to keep an eye on this place, right?

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Huh? The driver didn't see what was in the envelope,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: so I don't need to finish him off?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I believe he saw the photo that he wasn't supposed to see.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Yes, I'm about to start watching the building.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: You're about to watch the building?

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Take a good look. Slowly... Naturally.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: He appeared just like the fortuneteller said!

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Apparently, due to the plane crash,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: he came to notice the existence of this photo of Sardinia that was at Trish's house.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: We need to take care of him first.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Otherwise, he'll interfere once Trish arrives.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: I'll be the one to finish him off.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: We need to get close to him without him figuring out my true identity.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Risotto's ability is a mystery to me, as well.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Draw him out about two meters away from you.

dialogue.name: Diavolo
dialogue.speech: Then he'll definitely be within Emperor Crimson's range.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: What's this? My head... It hurts.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: O-Oh, yeah. I don't have time to worry about a headache.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I just had a call from the boss.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: My mission is to keep an eye on that building and... uh...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Right! I have to get closer!

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: I won't get closer to you.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: But I think I've seen him before...

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Otherwise, I can't see your face.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Why does this always happen to me?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The ignorance and fear in his expression are not an act.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: If he was from Passione, he wouldn't act like this.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Not to mention, he's more unguarded than a baby.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Stop fussing. I'm just going to pick up my knife.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: I don't care about you anymore.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I-I don't feel so good... My head hurts...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There was just one thing you did that seemed like an act.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: you reflexively hid the envelope so I wouldn't see it, didn't you?

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: It's right under your left shoe.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: If I'm satisfied with what I see, I'll leave.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I-I don't have any money! Just let me go!

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: It wasn't murderous intent or hostility, but your expression there seemed fake.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Stand up, move your left leg, and show me.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: I told you to stand up! Stand up!

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Oh, so it's just an envelope.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Your trembling certainly isn't an act,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and I can tell you're a coward who can't lie.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: But now... I'm even more interested in you.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: You heard that sound, too, didn't you?

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Just now, you glanced over toward that sound.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: And who are you to show up to such an important location?

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: It must mean that the boss trusts you greatly.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: But there is true fear in your heart.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You're the one who's about to be shaking in your boots!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Since you're running toward me, you must be a close-ranged power type.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: Your range is around two to three meters.

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: As long as I know that, I know how I'll k*ll you.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: I'll shove these razor blades right up your a*s!

dialogue.name: Risotto
dialogue.speech: I told you, I know how I'll k*ll you.

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Impossible! I'm not done yet, damn it!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: That's his... That's his assassin ability...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There just happens to be a pay phone in a place like this!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: If you are, please come quickly!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I cannot go there until you get close enough to him.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: if he happens to see me and then manages to escape.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: You need to get closer. You need to get within two meters of Risotto!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: Boss! I don't know what his ability is!

dialogue.name: Doppio
dialogue.speech: He could attack me again at any second!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Did you forget that I gave you a portion of my Emperor Crimson's power?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Now is the time to use it!
